## The Peekling

Tell us who this Peekling is, how it moves, and why you made it.

## Preview

Add a still image or short loop that shows the submitted atlas in motion.

## Rights and source

Describe where the artwork came from and confirm that `RIGHTS.json` tells the same story.

## Checklist

- [ ] This pull request adds, updates, or removes one Peekling Pack only.
- [ ] The Pack is in `peeklings/<lowercase-id>` and its manifest uses the same ID.
- [ ] `character.json`, every referenced PNG atlas, `thumbnail.png`, `README.md`, `LICENSE`, and `RIGHTS.json` are present.
- [ ] I made the artwork or have permission to redistribute it under the declared license.
- [ ] I disclosed generative tools in `RIGHTS.json`, including an empty disclosure when none were used.
- [ ] The Pack contains data and images only. It has no scripts, executable files, remote tracking, or telemetry.
- [ ] I read the [community guidelines](https://github.com/peekling/awesome-peeklings/blob/main/COMMUNITY_GUIDELINES.md).
- [ ] I ran `npm ci` and `npm run check` locally.

## Review notes

Point reviewers to any unusual animation timing, attribution requirement, or compatibility detail.
